_comment: Free-form placement rules. Platforms go anywhere in a band alongside the corridor, on either side, rather than on authored pads. min_distance_from_path keeps them off the road and its walls (corridor half-width 23 + wall 10 = 33). max_distance_from_path is what makes position a decision: far enough back and your range is wasted on empty ground. min_platform_spacing stops an infinite stack of turrets on one spot, and is the real constraint on how much firepower a corner can hold.
